name: War
source:
Not only is he an STX Space Force general and Blue Star military hero, but he also holds the record for most Consuelos defeated. Has currently pulled back from the front lines to organize his Elites… Date and place of birth unknown. Eliza’s closest confidant.

[i]“Yes, so I can remain human to the very end. That’s all there is to it.”[/i]

[From [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/3312]Shiravune[/url]]
